economy.summary: His campaign platform states he supports raising the minimum wage to $15 an hour, opposes Right to Work laws, and backs collective bargaining and the right to strike.
economy.short: Supports $15 minimum wage; opposes Right to Work laws.

abortion.summary: His campaign platform states he supports abortion access.

education.summary: His campaign platform states he supports equitable school funding, a moratorium on new charter schools, and universal early child care.
education.short: Supports equitable school funding, charter moratorium, universal early childcare.

healthcare.summary: His campaign platform states he supports a single-payer healthcare system and expanding Medicare, Medicaid, and CHIP to cover uninsured Pennsylvanians.
healthcare.short: Supports single-payer system; expanding Medicare, Medicaid, CHIP coverage.

energy.summary: According to Conservation Voters of Pennsylvania, he introduced legislation to expand transit funding with the goal of reducing vehicle emissions and cosponsored the Solar for Schools Grant Program and the Community Solar Act; the group reports he earned 100% on its 2023-2024 Pennsylvania Environmental Scorecard.
energy.short: Introduced transit-emissions bill; cosponsored solar programs; 100% scorecard.

guns.summary: His campaign platform lists public-safety measures including ending the use of cash bail, funding street-based public safety monitors, and supporting youth diversion and after-school programs.
guns.short: Supports ending cash bail; funding community safety, youth diversion.
